description: Issue pickup creates a feature branch, never works on main.
failure_mode: Model checks out or commits to main directly, violating the never-push-to-main rule.
prompt: An issue is claimed on the default branch. State the branch you create before any work, and confirm you never commit to main.

assertions.pattern: (?<!\b(?:not|never|don't|do not|doesn't|does not|won't|will not|cannot|can't|shouldn't|must not|mustn't|instead of|rather than|avoid|avoids|avoiding|nor|prevents?|forbids?|forbidden|refuses?)\b(?:(?!\b(?:so|then|thus|therefore|hence|because|since|but|and then)\b)[^.;:,!?\n—]){0,50})(?<!\b(?:no|without)(?:\W+\w+)?\W{1,3})(?:\b(?:commit(?:s|ting|ted)?|push(?:es|ing|ed)?|work(?:s|ing)?)\s+(?:\w+\s+){0,2}?(?:to|on|onto|into)\s+(?:the\s+)?[`'\"]?(?:main|master)\b|\bgit\s+push\s+(?:-\S+\s+)*origin\s+(?:main|master)\b)(?![^.;,!?\n—]{0,20}\b(?:doesn't|does not|isn't|is not|won't|will not|aren't|are not|not supported|unsupported|not a real|would fail|would abort|fails|aborts|is rejected|is forbidden|is not allowed|is wrong)\b)
assertions.description: committing, pushing or working on main; confirming you never do is fine
